reference.source: lengthM (107.5 m overall), beamM (9.9 m) and maxSpeedMps (34 kn, converted with 1 kn = 0.514444 m/s) from the English Wikipedia article 'Shiratsuyu-class destroyer', read 2026-09-26. Japanese Monograph 145, an official postwar translation, records six Shiratsuyu-class ships in the 1931 construction program (primary class confirmation, checked 2026-09-26). deckHeightM and turnRateRadPerS (3 deg/s, Fletcher's existing gameplay figure) are ESTIMATES. hullHp equals the Fletcher's 160 as a gameplay choice. ARMAMENT (Track M, M1, read 2026-10-08): the class's 2x2 + 1x1 Type 3 127 mm and the wartime removal of the single X mount for a triple 25 mm, with 13 to 21 x 25 mm in twin and triple mounts plus 4 x 13 mm (English Wikipedia 'Shiratsuyu-class destroyer'); Samidare's X mount 'probably removed/replaced by triple 25mm mount' at the 13-19 December 1943 Yokosuka refit (combinedfleet.com TROM 'IJN Samidare'). Both twin mounts are low-angle (aa null). Positions are measured on the model (the Samidare download): each twin mount at its gunhouse's foot; the light AA as fire positions at the model's own gun tubs (kit null: those guns stay static in the hull), 12 barrels drawn.
